mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate indicates monetary easing, which may lead to increased borrowing and investment, thereby driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 show no significant positive correlation with federal funds rate declines over a 5-year period.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate signals a strong labor market, which may lead to increased consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows negative returns in more than 40% of the 20-day windows following an unemployment rate drop below 5%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in both GDP and housing starts indicates strong economic demand, which may lead to increased corporate revenues and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If the correlation between the combined proxies and S&P 500 returns is not statistically significant over a 10-year period.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production suggests increased economic activity, which may lead to higher corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If industrial production growth does not correlate with positive S&P 500 returns in more than 50% of cases over a 5-year period.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in payroll employment suggests a strong labor market, which may lead to increased economic activity and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: If payroll employment growth does not correlate with positive S&P 500 returns in more than 40% of cases over a 3-year period.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in retail sales suggests strong consumer demand, which may lead to increased corporate revenues and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If retail sales growth does not correlate with positive S&P 500 returns in more than 50% of cases over a 5-year period.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of high federal funds rates and low unemployment rates may indicate a tightening monetary policy, leading to decreased borrowing and investment, and thus negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If the combined proxies do not show a significant negative correlation with S&P 500 returns over a 10-year period.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production suggests economic weakness, which may lead to decreased corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If industrial production declines do not correlate with negative S&P 500 returns in more than 50% of cases over a 5-year period.
